run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adsorbate-surface system and compute adsorption energy
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy using ML-relaxed adslab and DFT slab energies
compute_full_adsorption_energy: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with ML
compute_dft_adsorption_energy: compute DFT adsorption energy from precomputed relaxed adslab and slab reference energies
save_relaxed_atoms_json: save relaxed adslab and slab atoms as JSON-encoded strings in the results dictionary
